tools.name: newsroom_submit_local_packet
tools.description: Submit a complete, locally researched packet through Owner Studio local mode. This does not use the provider-backed drafter or publisher. The Site processes the owner’s local job directly and returns its latest status. Use a new UUID idempotencyKey for each packet and reuse it only for an exact retr

tools.name: newsroom_get_writer_job
tools.description: Read the status, private draft, and independent gate result for one Owner Studio writer job owned by the authenticated Site owner.

tools.name: newsroom_publish_reviewed_draft
tools.description: Publish one private Owner Studio draft only after editorial review. The server rechecks the independent gate, unresolved warnings, seven-day freshness, duplicate clearance, and revision integrity before making the article public.
